title: Senior IT Program & Project Management Analyst
description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission\-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments \- creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.
   

  

**Job Track Description:**
 The Senior IT Program \& Project Management Analyst is responsible for supporting the planning, execution, governance, reporting, and delivery of IT projects. This role partners with delivery teams, business stakeholders, product owners, and technology leaders to ensure successful delivery of IT initiatives.
   

  

 The position provides PMO leadership, project controls, portfolio reporting, risk and issue management, schedule governance, resource planning support, and executive\-level communications while driving consistency with organizational project management standards and best practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Governance**
* Support execution of multiple IT projects across the organization.
* Establish and maintain project governance processes, standards, and controls.
* Facilitate project reviews and status reporting.
* Ensure compliance with project management methodologies and organizational standards.
* Track project performance against scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives.


**Planning and Delivery Management**
* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, roadmaps, milestones, and dependencies.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams to ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.
* Monitor project progress and proactively identify schedule variances.
* Support release planning, implementation planning, and delivery readiness activities.


**Risk, Issue, and Dependency Management**
* Maintain project risk, issue, action item, and decision logs.
* Facilitate identification, assessment, and mitigation of delivery risks.
* Escalate critical issues and dependencies to leadership with recommended corrective actions.
* Monitor mitigation plans through resolution.


**Reporting and Executive Communication**
* Prepare executive\-level project status reports.
* Develop dashboards, KPIs, and portfolio metrics.
* Present project health, risks, achievements, and delivery forecasts to leadership.
* Generate management reports using project management and reporting tools.


**Financial Management**
* Assist with project budget monitoring and financial reporting.
* Track project expenditures and identify budget variances.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Collaborate with business leaders, technology teams, vendors, and customers.
* Facilitate meetings, workshops, planning sessions, and governance reviews.
* Drive stakeholder alignment on priorities, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
* Ensure effective communication across all levels of the organization.


**PMO Process Improvement**
* Identify opportunities for improving project delivery processes.
* Drive adoption of Agile, Scrum, SAFe, and project management best practices.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across the PMO.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in IT project management, PMO, or project governance roles.
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise technology initiatives.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies including Waterfall, Agile, Scrum, and SAFe.
* Experience managing cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams.


**Required Skills**
* Project management
* Project planning and scheduling
* Risk and issue management
* Stakeholder management
* Financial and resource management
* Executive reporting and presentations
* Requirements tracking and traceability
* Change management
* Vendor management
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills


**Preferred Tools Experience**
* Microsoft Project
* Azure DevOps (ADO)
* Microsoft Office
* Microsoft Power BI


**Preferred Certifications**
* PMP (Project Management Professional)
* SAFe Agilist (SA)
* PRINCE2 Practitioner
* Scrum Master Certification


 Conduent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, national origin, age, gender identity, gender expression, sex/gender, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, use of a guide dog or service animal, military/veteran status, citizenship status, basis of genetic information, or any other group protected by law.

Complete the form and then email it as an attachment to FTADAAA@conduent.com. You may also click here to access Conduent's ADAAA Accommodation Policy.

title: Systems Integration Senior Specialist
description:
**AI Business Analyst – Job Description**
 Mandatory Requirements
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience working as a Business Analyst or Systems Analyst in technology\-driven environments.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, data\-driven decision\-making, analytics workflows, and modern digital platforms.
* Proven experience working across the product development lifecycle (requirements, design, UAT, go‑live, and post‑implementation support).
* Ability to understand, analyze, and translate complex business processes into functional and technical requirements.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to research, interpret, and present insights to drive business solutions.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of working with stakeholders at all organizational levels.
* Experience with data analysis, KPI definition, dashboarding, and converting analytical findings into business value.
* Familiarity with predictive modelling, AI solution use cases, automation opportunities, and workflow optimization.
* Experience collaborating with engineering, QA, data science, and product teams in fast\-paced environments.


**Responsibilities**
 Business Analysis \& Requirements
   

  

* Elicit, gather, and document business requirements for AI, analytics, and automation initiatives.
* Convert business needs into functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Serve as the bridge between business teams, AI/ML teams, product owners, and engineering.
* Participate in solutioning workshops to align business needs with technical capabilities.


 AI/ML \& Data Solution Support
   

  

* Work with data scientists to translate business challenges into AI/ML use cases and measurable outcomes.
* Assist in model validation, data quality checks, feature inputs, and business interpretation of model results.
* Help define KPIs, measurement criteria, and success metrics for AI\-driven processes.
* Support development of analytics dashboards, reporting frameworks, and decision\-support tools.


 Project Execution \& Collaboration
   

  

* Support solution design activities including process optimization, automation, and data transformation.
* Perform data analysis, validation, mapping, and transformation for system inputs/outputs.
* Participate in and support all testing cycles including functional testing, UAT, and regression.
* Develop user guides, training materials, and conduct stakeholder training sessions.
* Assist in project planning, tracking activities, documentation preparation, and project communication.


 Implementation \& Post\-Implementation
   

  

* Support integrations between AI systems, enterprise platforms, and third\-party applications.
* Monitor system performance, help troubleshoot issues, and recommend continuous improvements.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to ensure smooth product rollouts and enhancements.


 Key Skills
   

  

* Requirements analysis \& documentation
* Process modelling (BPMN, flowcharts, user journeys)
* AI/ML concepts (basic understanding of models, data pipelines, automation logic)
* Data analysis \& visualization (Excel, SQL, Power BI, Tableau)
* Agile methodologies, JIRA/Confluence
* Strong problem\-solving and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to work independently and lead cross\-functional discussions


 Optional / Good\-to\-Have
   

  

* Experience in RPA, intelligent automation, or conversational AI.
* Background in product\-based or platform\-based solution design.
* Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Certifications in Business Analysis (CBAP, CCBA), Product Ownership, or Agile.

title: Technical Lead
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Java Full Stack Technical Lead, you will be expected to work as a self\-driven individual contributor with strong ownership of end\-to\-end design, development, and delivery of product features across both backend and frontend layers. You should be hands\-on in Java\-based backend services, REST APIs, microservices, cloud\-native deployments, and modern frontend development using frameworks such as React or Angular. Along with independent technical contribution, the role requires mentoring junior engineers in the team, guiding implementation decisions, reviewing code, ensuring secure and high\-quality delivery, supporting customer escalations, and driving innovation through PoCs and continuous improvements.
   

  

**Job Requirement And Responsibilities**
* The Java Full Stack Technical Lead will be responsible for independently leading product feature development across backend and frontend layers, including design, implementation, validation, and delivery of scalable software applications and systems.
* The candidate should be hands\-on and technically strong enough to contribute as an individual contributor while also providing technical leadership, design direction, code reviews, and guidance to the team.
* Mandatory experience is required in both backend engineering using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, databases, and cloud\-native patterns, as well as frontend engineering using React or Angular, TypeScript/JavaScript, UI integration, and responsive web application development.
* You need to follow development processes and security processes, and will ensure the technical quality of the solution with UTs coverage and handle/identify security vulnerabilities.
* You will work on Customers escalated issues.
* You will get exposure to working on cutting\-edge technologies and innovation events.
* Drive innovation by proposing, prototyping, and evaluating new technical solutions (PoCs), and contribute to continuous improvements in performance, scalability, and developer productivity.
* Contribute innovative ideas for technical improvements and processes.
* Technologies should not be a constraint for the right person; however, strong hands\-on exposure to Java full stack development is mandatory. The role involves Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, React or Angular, TypeScript/JavaScript, Kubernetes, and ownership of deployments and chart definitions for our applications.


**Job Knowledge, Skill And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics and Communication, or a related discipline, with 10\+ years of application development experience, including strong hands\-on Java full stack development across backend and frontend technologies.
* Strong hands\-on experience in designing and implementing REST API based backend applications using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot frameworks.
* Strong exposure to frontend technologies such as React or Angular is mandatory, with the ability to collaborate on UI architecture, review frontend implementation, and ensure seamless integration with backend services.
* Core knowledge in Data Structures, OOPS, Solid design principles, and common Design Patterns is must.
* Working exposure to any cloud stack (GCP, AWS) is must.
* Leveraging AI in routine work or personal POCs will be an added advantage.
* Exposure to Cloud and Kubernetes\-based applications will be an important factor.
* The ideal candidate should be technology\-agnostic, adaptable, and comfortable learning and working across different languages, frameworks, and platforms as required.
* Hands\-on experience with a modern cloud\-friendly programming language such as Python or Node.js. will be an added advantage.
* Experience in Unit Testing and any automation (BDD) framework will be nice to have.
* Good exposure to any relational database MSSQL or MySql.
* Exposure in Micro Services architecture and Docker based application will be an added advantage.


**What do we offer?**
 At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!
   

  

 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Manager - Customer Service Transformation And AI
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Consulting –** 
**Manager\- Customer Service Transformation and AI**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The
 **Manager – Customer Service Transformation and AI** 
 will drive AI\-led service transformation initiatives within the Customer practice, combining service strategy, AI solution design, process improvement, and delivery excellence. The role will support clients in reimagining service journeys, contact centre operations, field service, and knowledge\-enabled support models through responsible use of AI, automation, analytics, and workflow orchestration. You will work with senior stakeholders to identify transformation opportunities, shape practical roadmaps, and deliver measurable improvements in customer experience, service productivity, resolution quality, and operating efficiency.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Business Development \& Market Leadership**
* Support the development of AI\-led service transformation opportunities across advisory and implementation engagements, contributing to pipeline growth and client relationship expansion.
* Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, solution narratives, and executive presentations focused on service modernization, AI adoption, and customer operations improvement.
* Support GTM development for AI\-enabled service offerings across sectors, including contact center transformation, intelligent case management, field service optimization, and digital self\-service.
* Develop reusable assets, accelerators, and points of view on AI\-led service transformation, customer operations, and service experience modernization.
* Stay current on emerging service models, AI adoption patterns, automation trends, and customer expectations that may influence client service transformation priorities.


**Client Engagement \& Delivery**
* Lead workstreams within service transformation programs from current\-state assessment through roadmap design, implementation planning, and adoption support.
* Assess service processes, customer journeys, operating models, channel mix, agent workflows, knowledge management practices, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
* Design AI\-enabled service operating models, service blueprints, automation use cases, governance structures, and adoption roadmaps aligned to client business outcomes.
* Support implementation of AI use cases such as virtual agents, agent assist, intelligent routing, case summarization, sentiment insights, knowledge search, predictive service, and workflow automation.
* Partner with technology, data, and business teams to translate service pain points into business requirements, solution concepts, process maps, and delivery\-ready backlogs.
* Develop business cases and benefits models to quantify productivity gains, containment improvement, average handle time reduction, service quality improvement, and cost\-to\-serve impact.
* Ensure delivery quality across assigned workstreams, including scope management, stakeholder coordination, milestone tracking, issue resolution, and executive reporting.
* Support change management and adoption activities to improve stakeholder readiness, responsible AI usage, and operational sustainability.


**Technology \& Innovation**
* Enable teams to leverage AI, automation, analytics, CRM, contact center platforms, knowledge management systems, and workflow tools to improve service outcomes.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to define data, integration, and governance considerations required for AI\-enabled service transformation.
* Identify opportunities to build accelerators, prototypes, and reusable methods for AI\-enabled service discovery, solution design, and benefits tracking.


**Leadership \& People Development**
* Manage small to mid\-sized project teams or workstreams, ensuring high\-quality deliverables, structured problem solving, and timely execution.
* Coach consultants and analysts on service transformation methods, requirements structuring, stakeholder engagement, and AI\-led operating model design.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Experience with AI\-enabled service use cases such as virtual agents, agent assist, intelligent routing, case summarization, and predictive service insights.
* Exposure to service platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service, ServiceNow CSM, Genesys, NICE, Amazon Connect, or similar technologies.
* Industry experience across B2B, professional services, technology, manufacturing, consumer, healthcare, utilities, or financial services sectors.


**What We Look For**
* 8\+ years of experience in service transformation, customer operations, contact center transformation, field service transformation, digital service, or AI\-enabled operations improvement.
* Consulting experience is desired.
* Proven experience supporting or leading service transformation initiatives from assessment through implementation planning and adoption.
* Strong understanding of service journeys, contact center operations, case management, knowledge management, service KPIs, and customer experience improvement levers.
* Hands\-on experience with AI, automation, analytics, CRM, service platforms, or digital workflow tools in customer service environments.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, problem\-solving, and project delivery skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Jira Master
description:
**About Parksmart:** 




 Parksmart Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a smart parking and mobility technology company providing technology\-driven parking and access management solutions across residential societies, commercial properties, hotels, hospitals, and other establishments.
 



**Job Overview:** 


 We are looking for a Jira Master who will be responsible for managing Jira, optimizing workflows, tracking projects and tasks, and ensuring effective adoption of Jira across different teams. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of Jira administration, Agile processes, workflow management, dashboards, and automation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Manage and administer Jira projects, users, roles, and permissions.
 



 • Create and maintain workflows, issue types, custom fields, screens, and notifications.
 



 • Track project progress, tasks, bugs, priorities, and deadlines.
 



 • Create dashboards, reports, filters, and project metrics for management.
 



 • Configure Jira automation to streamline repetitive tasks and processes.
 



 • Work closely with teams to understand requirements and configure Jira accordingly.
 



 • Monitor Jira usage and ensure teams follow defined processes.
 



 • Troubleshoot Jira\-related issues and provide support to users.
 



 • Coordinate with Product, Technology, Operations, and other teams for effective project tracking. • Maintain Jira documentation and continuously improve workflows and processes.
 



 • Support Agile/Scrum ceremonies and ensure proper task tracking in Jira.
 



 • Manage or coordinate Jira integrations with tools such as Confluence, Slack, Git, etc. 
 



  





**Requirements •** 




 2–5 years of experience in Jira administration, Jira management, or a similar role.
 



 • Strong hands\-on knowledge of Jira Software.
 



 • Experience with Jira workflows, dashboards, automation, permissions, and reporting.
 



 • Good understanding of Agile, Scrum, and Kanban methodologies.
 



 • Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills.
 



 • Good communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
